summary:
Your GitHub contributions — as a cinematic SVG monolith.

Drop this into your GitHub profile README and stop being boring.

Transform your GitHub contribution history into a cinematic 3D monolith.

For all URL parameters and configuration possibilities (including grace periods, custom fonts, timezone overrides, versus comparison mode, heatmap view, LOC mode, and layout dimensions).

For advanced usage examples including custom gradient backgrounds, multi-user comparisons, organization dashboards, and custom date ranges, see the 🚀 Advanced Usage Examples section in the customization guide.

CommitPulse transforms GitHub contribution data into visually engaging and highly customizable SVG badges.
audience: New contributors who need an evidence-first repository orientation

architecture.description: Evidence map generated from retrieved repository documents. It is not a guessed runtime dependency graph; run analysis again when the language model is available for a richer architecture explanation.

firstPrPath.title: Read the repository context
actions: Review README.md, issues/2129, issues/5499, issues/8776 before changing code.
firstPrPath.outcome: You know which repository evidence is available.

firstPrPath.title: Trace the smallest change
actions: Find the existing entrypoint or source path related to your issue.
Follow the repository’s current conventions instead of introducing a new pattern.
firstPrPath.outcome: The change is scoped to existing repository structure.

firstPrPath.title: Verify before opening a PR
actions: Run the documented checks from the repository context.
Inspect the final diff and describe the evidence used in the pull request.
firstPrPath.outcome: The contribution is reviewable and its verification is recorded.

questionsToExplore: Which existing test or check covers the area I want to change?
What does the contribution guide require before opening a PR?
